text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yawn… Ooh, my eyes are watery… Maybe I've been reading my grimoire too much.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But I've learned a ton! I even learned how to summon a meteor!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: First, I get a crystal and some salt… Then I take the crystal and… I…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uh… Um, what was it again?
